+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(
+			types.NewObject(nil, &types.DynamicProperty{Key: types.S, Value: types.A}),
+			types.S,
+		), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	authentication := input.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	var expected auth.Method
+	switch string(key.Value.(ast.String)) {
+	case "token":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN
+	case "oidc":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC
+	case "kubernetes", "k8s":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES
+	case "github":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB
+	case "jwt":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_JWT
+	case "cloud":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", key.Value)
+	}
+
+	method := authentication.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(method != nil && method.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(expected)))), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3383a7a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+// A wrong method code or alias mapping must change the policy result.
+func TestIsAuthMethodMatchesProtocolCodes(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name string
+		code int
+	}{
+		{"token", 1},
+		{"oidc", 2},
+		{"kubernetes", 3},
+		{"k8s", 3},
+		{"github", 4},
+		{"jwt", 5},
+		{"cloud", 6},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			query := `flipt.is_auth_method(input, "` + tt.name + `")`
+			for _, check := range []struct {
+				code int
+				want bool
+			}{{tt.code, true}, {0, false}} {
+				results, err := rego.New(rego.Query(query), rego.Input(map[string]any{
+					"authentication": map[string]any{"method": check.code},
+				})).Eval(context.Background())
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Len(t, results, 1)
+				require.Equal(t, check.want, results[0].Expressions[0].Value)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// Removing the missing-authentication check must expose a different result.
+func TestIsAuthMethodRejectsMissingAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "token")`),
+		rego.Input(map[string]any{}),
+		rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+	).Eval(context.Background())
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+}
+
+// Accepting unknown labels must fail with the supplied label in the error.
+func TestIsAuthMethodRejectsUnsupportedMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "saml")`),
+		rego.Input(map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 1}}),
+		rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+	).Eval(context.Background())
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unsupported auth method") && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "saml"), err)
+}
